edition_angle: Uncovering cellular clearing mechanisms and lysosomal pathways in neurodegenerative stress.

assignments.angle: Investigating how a GPNMB-driven lysosomal and autolysosomal program within disease-associated microglia responds to neurodegenerative stress and progranulin/TMEM106B deficiency.
assignments.reason: This study offers a concrete cellular and transcriptomic mechanism showing how microglial lysosomal and autolysosomal catabolic programs directly correlate with neurodegeneration in frontotemporal lobar degeneration and Alzheimer's disease models, filling a critical biological gap under the Dark Mirror spiral.
